# Lucide icons

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

The files in `icons/` are the upstream SVG sources used to create GIR's native Android settings vectors. They are retained here so each production symbol can be audited against its source. See `LICENSE` for the ISC and applicable Feather-derived MIT terms.

Included icons: `settings`, `arrow-left`, `bot`, `circle-user-round`, `palette`, `flask-conical`, `square-terminal`, `shield-check`, and `chevron-right`.
